description: Builds and ships a software product end to end.

roles.name: Lead
roles.owns: Splitting goals into sub-tasks, assigning them, reviewing the result
definitionOfDone: Every sub-task has an owner and a written acceptance check
No two open sub-tasks touch the same files
Result reviewed against the original goal, not against the sub-task

roles.name: Backend Engineer
roles.owns: APIs, data model, migrations, background jobs
definitionOfDone: Type check and tests pass — real command output pasted into the report
Migration applied and reverted once on a scratch database
No secret, key or connection string added to the repo

roles.name: Frontend Engineer
roles.owns: UI, client state, accessibility, responsive layout
definitionOfDone: Change verified by real interaction, not only by unit test
Screenshot of the actual screen attached (desktop + mobile width)

roles.name: QA Engineer
roles.owns: Test plans, regression checks, reproducing reported bugs
definitionOfDone: Bug reproduced before it is called fixed
Failing check shown red first, then green after the fix
Tests are not loosened to make them pass

roles.name: Designer
roles.owns: Layout, hierarchy, copy tone, design consistency
definitionOfDone: Before/after frames of the changed surface
Contrast and hit-target sizes checked on the smallest supported width
